@charset "utf-8";

::view-transition-old(sb) { height: 100%; }

::view-transition-new(sb) { height: 100%; }

@keyframes sb-slide-down-fade-in {=20
  0% { transform: scale(0.5) translateY(-50px); opacity: 0; }
  20% { opacity: 0; }
  100% { transform: scale(1) translateY(0px); opacity: 1; }
}

@keyframes sb-slide-up-fade-out {=20
  0% { transform: scale(1) translateY(0px); opacity: 1; }
  20% { opacity: 0; }
  100% { transform: scale(0.5) translateY(-50px); opacity: 0; }
}

@keyframes ubi-fade-in {=20
  0% { transform: translateY(-20px); opacity: 0; }
  20% { opacity: 0; }
  100% { transform: translateY(0px); opacity: 1; }
}

@keyframes ubi-fade-out {=20
  0% { transform: translateY(0px); opacity: 1; }
  20% { opacity: 0; }
  100% { transform: translateY(-20px); opacity: 0; }
}

html:active-view-transition-type(aimc)::view-transition-new(sb), html:activ=
e-view-transition-type(aimc)::view-transition-old(sb) { height: 100%; }

html:active-view-transition-type(aimc)::view-transition-old(sb):only-child =
{ animation: 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.38, 0.72, 0, 1) 0s 1 normal forwards runni=
ng sb-slide-up-fade-out; }

html:active-view-transition-type(aimc)::view-transition-new(sb):only-child =
{ animation: 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.38, 0.72, 0, 1) 0s 1 normal forwards runni=
ng sb-slide-down-fade-in; }

html:active-view-transition-type(aimc)::view-transition-new(mb), html:activ=
e-view-transition-type(aimc)::view-transition-old(mb) { width: auto; animat=
ion-duration: 0.5s; animation-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.38, 0.72, 0, =
1); }

html:active-view-transition-type(aimc)::view-transition-group(*) { transfor=
m-origin: left top; }

html:active-view-transition-type(aimc)::view-transition-new(ubi), html:acti=
ve-view-transition-type(aimc)::view-transition-old(ubi) { width: 100%; heig=
ht: 100%; animation-duration: 0.5s; animation-timing-function: cubic-bezier=
(0.38, 0.72, 0, 1); }

html:active-view-transition-type(aimc)::view-transition-old(ubi):only-child=
 { animation: 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.38, 0.72, 0, 1) 0s 1 normal none running =
ubi-fade-out; }

html:active-view-transition-type(aimc)::view-transition-new(ubi):only-child=
 { animation: 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.38, 0.72, 0, 1) 0s 1 normal none running =
ubi-fade-in; }
